cross_entry_constraints.meaning: One shared state for all six entries

result.algorithm: Enumerate Ashmole F01/F03/F05 joint entry signatures; conditionally optimize Morgan F04/F06 full entry signatures independently. F02 has zero contrast weight but stays in all15 pairs.
result.arithmetic: Exact integer numerators over32; rational output reduced. No per-coordinate domain relaxation.
limitations: Conditional frozen-name branch only; strict branch undefined.
Exact over supplied joint signature sets, not necessarily biologically realizable or statistically sharp.
Input domains must already preserve within-entry candidate dependencies; unsupported cross-entry constraints are not inferred.
Pair extrema are marginal and must not be combined as one global assignment.
Numerical agreement is not independent image/name evidence.

cross_entry_model.justification: Shared outer g is fixed to all_zero; this conditional product is the reviewed conservative enclosure only. Original constraints remain in outer packet.
